verdict.rationale: Tilled's docs show API-driven merchant onboarding (create/edit applications, no-code and OnboardingJS options, API keys with scoped per-merchant headers), which supports agent-driven account creation and onboarding via the API. However there is no mention of a 'requirements-due' status concept or API endpoint for surfacing outstanding onboarding requirements, and no MCP surface exists — the runtime probe confirms no llms.txt/agent-oriented docs index, meaning agent access is API-only with no first-class agent integration layer. Missing for 10: requirements-due state API, MCP server/tool surface, agent-specific docs or scoped-credential guidance for autonomous agents.
